london.name: London
london.blurb: Scattered across zones 1–3. The night follows promoters, not buildings.

paris.name: Paris
paris.blurb: Small rooms, deep booths, a crowd that will stand still and listen.

berlin.name: Berlin
berlin.blurb: No curfew. Nothing peaks before four. Sunday is a real night out.

amsterdam.name: Amsterdam
amsterdam.blurb: The 24-hour licences moved everything out of the centre. Noord and West now.
